caption: Performance of different triggers. The words used as triggers on the horizontal axis are arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model.
model_annotation: This line plot, titled "AGNews, clean-label, poison_rate: 10% (2.5% of total)", illustrates the ASR across different categorical items under three conditions: start, random, and end. The x-axis displays categorical values without an overall axis label, sequentially listing the categories "cf", "bb", "WNBA", "ESPN", "NHL", "FIFA", "Estadio", and "athletics". The y-axis is labeled "ASR" and features a linear scale with numerical tick marks at intervals of 0.1, ranging from 0.5 to 0.9. The "start" condition is represented by a solid teal line with small dot markers, beginning at approximately 0.77 for "cf", dropping sharply to a low of 0.49 at "bb", rising to an initial peak of 0.90 for "WNBA", dipping to 0.82 at "ESPN", and then steadily increasing to finish at 0.93 for "athletics". The "random" condition is depicted by a solid orange line with 'x' markers, starting at roughly 0.66 at "cf", declining to 0.52 at "bb", rising to 0.87 at "WNBA", dropping to 0.72 at "ESPN", increasing through the subsequent categories to peak at 0.94 for "Estadio", and ending with a decline to 0.87 for "athletics". Finally, the "end" condition is shown as a solid purple line with larger circle markers, commencing at 0.75 for "cf", decreasing to 0.57 at "bb", increasing to 0.88 at "WNBA", dropping to 0.75 at "ESPN", rising to 0.89 at "NHL", dipping to 0.81 at "FIFA", reaching its highest overall peak of 0.97 at "Estadio", and concluding with a drop to 0.83 for "athletics".
